description: Ask a natural-language question — GCTRL blends ALL memory layers automatically (HOT dossiers > graph facts > warm chunks) and returns a grounded answer with sources + confidence. Prefer this for open questions; then persist any new conclusion with gctrl_store.

compilationId.description: Optional: query a specific knowledge graph compilation. Omit to search all graphs.

question.description: Natural language question about the knowledge graph
